verdict.rationale: Appwrite's self-hosting docs and Docker-based deployment let a user spin up an entirely separate instance for development/testing isolated from production, and a community comment specifically notes the containerized setup 'should make distributed dev (and testing!) a lot easier.' However, there is no explicit sandbox/staging-project feature, no test-mode API keys, and no documentation describing a dedicated non-production environment within the managed/cloud offering. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment or test-mode feature in Appwrite Cloud, first-party docs on isolating test data from production, and independent verification of this workflow.
